runtime: plate-engine (TFLite 2.16.1 + XNNPACK 2 threads with the OpenCL GPU delegate for the detector/readers and the 128/256-wide text crops, ONNX Runtime 1.30.0 CPU)
region_model: PP-OCRv6 original absolute CTC probability with Japanese region lexicon
numeric_baseline: Reader-v1, with tightly checked PP-OCR classification votes and low-confidence serial completion
limitations: small public development sets; not an untouched final benchmark
labels reviewed by assistant, not independent human annotators
actual Pixel driving accuracy and end-to-end detector recall not measured
night_behavior: Unread region/kana: exact full-line context, two crop views, geometric word score and known class/serial checks; bounded contrast auxiliary for unread regions. Additional night-trained and Japanese-v3 candidate weights were not adopted.

night_candidate_training.reason: No end-to-end kana gain on the recorded cohorts; raw validation correctness fell despite a small high-confidence coverage gain

frame_color_policy.range: Honor full or limited range per frame; unknown metadata retains legacy limited range

runtime_tuning.reason: XNNPACK candidate crashes on first width-95 input; CPU3 is faster and numerically close to CPU2

text_ocr_model.head: pruned to the 273 characters used on Japanese plates (ppocrv5_r2-dictionary.json)
text_ocr_model.fine_tune: group, region and kana balanced real sampling with rendered and generated synthetic plates; blank (abstain) targets for plates narrower than 34 px, ramping to full weight at 46 px; 3000 steps, CTC + KL distillation, BN frozen, p^2 confidence sharpening
text_ocr_model.training_data: owner photos and dash-camera crops (not shipped, not published), rendered synthetic plates, and photoreal synthetic plates generated from fictional plate text with image-edited condition variants (night glare, rain, dusk, tunnel lighting), kept only when a VLM read back every field
text_ocr_model.gpu_models: ppocrv6s_r4_w128.tflite / ppocrv6s_r4_w256.tflite: the same weights as fixed-width float32 TFLite for the OpenCL GPU delegate (tools/plate/gpu/convert_rec_tflite.sh --attention)

serial_check_model: ppocrv6_rec_np1_int8.onnx (upstream INT8 PP-OCRv6, fastMaxInputWidth 128) with ppocrv6_rec.onnx as fall-back, used only for the serial-number check (textOcr.numberModel); ppocrv6_rec_np1_w8.mnn is not used by this configuration
evaluation: docs/plate-lowres-evaluation.md (device end-to-end, field-eval-web-v1 dev/test, plate widths 55-120 px)
